hospitalPolicy: Isolated evaluator only, no task selection or thresholds depend on a hospital name

implementation: One pure ranking worker per bridge process, serialized scheduling, waiting/active deadlines

Localized within-room progress counts in task center

failedOverheadAudit.explanation: Initial worker response/numerical checks passed but exceeded the predeclared20% runtime-overhead gate; subsequent per-call source check reuse changed neither evidence nor thresholds.

harnessLimit.initialFailure: First old-code probe reported fetch failed and stopped before saving canonical plans. Original failed report retained. Its initial harness source was not separately snapshotted; that run is not promoted as a numerical pass.
harnessLimit.improvement: Subsequent identical harness records detailed transport failures without losing completed ranking data; all completed variants reproduce the same hash.

limits: Only this unchanged known model and host passed the stated response gates, not every project size/CPU/memory load or machine
